sample_unit: validation samples (clinical samples, spike-ins and controls)
unlisted_practices: Combining structured decision trees with LLM reasoning to formalize expert adjudication in metagenomic diagnostics
Providing clinical notes as context to the LLM classifier to improve diagnostic performance
Locally deployed open-weight reasoning models for diagnostic interpretation
Automated adjudication for systematic benchmarking of computational parameters and regression testing

screen.reason: The study evaluates an LLM-based diagnostic classifier combining structured decision trees and LLM reasoning to interpret metagenomic sequencing results compared to expert consensus on clinical specimens, but it does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
